value.rationale: This is a natural strengthening of a 2026 weak Bergman-to-Fock degeneration on the same centered-ball sharp symbols, not an arbitrary numerical slice. It gives positive spectral ordering in all dimensions, an exact whole-spectrum trace-class discrepancy, a trace-class first-order limit, and the sharp changing holomorphic degree responsible for the worst norm error. The error-mode switch is not readable from the two individual operator norms and supplies a meaningful quantitative benchmark.
